lines.text: Here's what really happens when you vibe edit a video.
One. The brief. You write what you want in plain words. The length, the mood, the look.
Two. The assets. Your footage, your music, your voiceover. Real files, in one folder.
Three. The agent. An AI reads your brief, looks at your files, and writes code. Every cut, every caption, every sound becomes a line.
Four. The render. The computer draws every frame, thirty times a second, and stitches them into a video.
Five. You. You watch it, give notes, and the agent rewrites the code. Until it feels right.
Brief. Assets. Agent. Render. Notes. That's the whole machine behind vibe editing.
